PROFILE

 Experienced Software Engineer with 8+ years in backend development, skilled in Java, J2EE and proficient in designing and maintaining Microservices-based Distributed applications.

 Experience in Database technologies (SǪL & NoSql) & DevOps practices, including GCP,

Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines, with a strong background in Agile methodologies.

 Successfully led projects in autonomous driving simulation software, providing mentorship to junior engineers, fostering technical innovation and optimizing scalability.

SKILLS

Languages (Java, J2EE, DSAs, Angular JS, ReactJs, HTML, JavaScript, Typescript, HTML, CSS, PHP)

Other Tech (REST, SOAP API, Unix, Linux)

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Capgemini, Tech Lead	April 2025 – Oct 2025 | Pune

Leading development team creating a real-time banking app for HSBC bank on springboot.

CI/CD Implementation using Bitbucket, Maven, Cloud Run, GKE.

Created Microservices and deployed on GKE Cluster.

Used REST Template to call third party APIs.

Technologies: Java, MongoDB,REDIS, ActiveMQ, PostSpringboot, REST, Maven, Openshift, Oracle, Angular, Docker, Kubernetes.

Hcl Technologies Germany GmbH, Tech Lead	Nov 2020 – Oct 2024 | Berlin

Leading development team creating a real-time banking app for deutsche bank on springboot.

Involved in various SDLC, including requirement gathering, and analysis, feasibility study, architectural design, software development & debugging, testing & deployment.

CI/CD Implementation using Bitbucket, Maven, Teamscity, Open shift.

Used Rest Controller in Spring framework to create RESTful Webservices and JSON objects for communication

Designed web page application using Angular by creating components, services, interface and mapping it to the backend API's

Created Angular 7 Service which interacts with RESTful services at backend.

Wrote Junit test cases for the respective classes using mockito.

Converting legacy application to SPRINGBOOT and MICROSERVICES

Experienced in developing SQL queries in Various database such as Oracle and mySQL,

Prepared database scripts on DDL, DML, DQL and TCL.

Used chrome developer tools to involve the Angular errors and debugger to test the

backend code.

Proactively learning GCP cloud to excel the cutting-edge technologies!

Technologies: Java, Springboot, REST, Maven, Openshift, Oracle, Angular, Docker, Kubernetes

Accenture, Senior Analyst	April 2019 – Nov 2020 | Pune Member of development team building Edgepark web application for the US Cardinal Health care services.

A keen Analyst and Team player with thorough understanding of all aspects of SDLC from interacting with business for requirements, analyzing into technical specifications

and driving the execution.

Responsible for requirement analysis, feasibility study, architectural design, software development & debugging, testing & deployment.

Well versed with configuration of DevOps tools such as Jenkins CI/CD pipel ines for automated deployment, Github, Kubernetes, OpenShift.

Created services to integrate KAFKA into existing microservices architecture to allow event driven trade messages data flow

Technologies: Java, Springboot, REST, Microservices,Gradle, PostgreSǪL, Mapr, CI/CD, Jenkins, AWS

Lnt Infotech, Software Associate	May 2015 – Sept 2018 | Pune

Member of API and Core Services Team for Perfios, a market leader in Fintech industry

Proficient in Java OOPs, well versed with SDLC and SAFe Agile methodology tracking story in JIRA. Expertise in Spring Core, MVC and Boot with RESTful web services, Hibernate and design patterns.

Experience in writing quality code, analyzing, debugging and troubleshooting bugs.

Worked on Selenium and Cucumber Automation Testing for BDD. Technologies: Java, MySql, Soap Api, SpringMVC, hibernate.
